The '''Micro Holo Suit''' was a model of [[Holographic Costume]] produced by [[Plescinia Entertainments/Legends|Plescinia Entertainments]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Micro Holo Suit was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
